reviews.snippet:
If you're traveling on the Hyderabad-Bangalore highway and looking for a great place to stop for a meal, Hotel Pranav is an excellent choice. Whether you're in the mood for breakfast, lunch, or dinner, this place offers delicious food and a comfortable dining experience.

Food & Drinks

One of the highlights here is their filter coffee—rich, aromatic, and perfectly brewed, making it a must-try for coffee lovers. Their menu caters to different mealtimes, ensuring you get a satisfying meal regardless of when you stop.

Hygiene & Convenience

Cleanliness is a top priority at Hotel Pranav. The washrooms and handwash stations are well-maintained and stocked at all times, which is especially important for female travelers. There's also a dedicated bathroom area that helps mothers with diaper changes and cleaning up their little ones, making it a family-friendly stop.

Ambiance & Location

The location adds to the charm, with a water body right across the highway, offering a scenic view and making the stop even more refreshing. The pleasant weather in this area enhances the experience, making it a great place to relax before continuing your journey.
